session.title: Craft
session.none: No sessions yet. Start one to ask an agent to build.
session.noneSelected: Pick a session, or start a new one.
session.unavailable: This session is not available in the current workspace.

preview.title: Web app preview
preview.downHint: Its dev server has stopped — a start that was interrupted, or a sandbox that restarted. Ask the agent to start the web app again; this pane picks it up on its own as soon as it's serving.
preview.passHint: The web app is running; its one-time preview pass is being exchanged. If it does not open, check again for a fresh pass.
preview.exchangeSameOrigin: The preview pass came back pointing at this page's own address, so it was not used. Open the platform from a different address to use the preview.
preview.exchangeForeignOrigin: The preview pass came back for a different address than this app's preview, so it was not used. Check again for a fresh pass.
preview.exchangeNonHttp: The preview pass came back for an address this pane cannot open, so it was not used. Check again for a fresh pass.
preview.closedTitle: Preview is unavailable on this deployment
preview.sameOriginHint: This page is being accessed through the preview's own address, so opening the preview would let the app act as this site. Open the platform from a different address to use the preview.
preview.legacyNotice: This app was built before the new preview origin, and its preview shares the platform's own origin: generated code can use your session to reach platform APIs. Rebuild the web app to move it onto the isolated preview origin; until then this preview keeps using the legacy path until the session ends.
preview.emptyTitle: Waiting for the first web app
preview.emptyHint: The web app the agent builds renders here, live.
preview.emptyTabs: Workspace files land under Files; downloads under Artifacts.

files.error: The file tree could not be loaded.

chat.emptyHint: Describe what you want — the agent builds it in its own sandbox and ships a web app, files, and artifacts.

subagent.title: Subagent
subagent.empty: The subagent has not produced any output yet.

tasks.title: Scheduled tasks
tasks.description: Prompts the agent runs on a schedule, headless. Times are UTC.
tasks.editorHint: The schedule compiles to a cron expression evaluated in UTC; the server refuses what it cannot schedule.
tasks.loadError: The scheduled tasks could not be loaded.
tasks.empty: No scheduled tasks yet. Create one to have the agent work on a schedule.
tasks.name: Name
tasks.weekdaysHint: Leave all unselected to run every day.
tasks.cronHint: Five fields, evaluated in UTC — e.g. 0 9 * * 1-5.
tasks.requiredError: Name, prompt and — in cron mode — the expression are required.

banner.awaitingApproval: Scheduled task "{{name}}" is waiting for approval
